spanish: Y si disuadiera su padre a ella en día de su oír, todos sus votos y sus ataduras que ató sobre su alma no se levantarán, y Jehová perdonará a ella, porque disuadió su padre a ella.

findings.issue: Hiphil perfect is rendered as imperfect subjunctive, a remoter hypothetical than the completed protasis.
Disuadir narrows hiphil H5106 toward persuasion by reasons; the stem licenses restrain or forbid without naming the means.
Qal imperfect 3ms is pluralized to agree with the vows and bonds; the claim that they do not stand is unchanged.

notes: Actors, objects, repetition, Jehová, and her binding on her soul match the tokens.
